item.title: Samsung to expand 2026 TV LCD buys from BOE as TCL orders drop
item.summary: Samsung Electronics is set to increase its TV LCD panel purchases in 2026, even as global shipments of TV LCDs are forecast to decline. The buying shift will favor BOE Technology Group and reduce Samsung's reliance on TCL China Star Optoelectronics Technology (TCL CSOT), according to ZDNet Korea , citing market research firm Omdia.
